smalltalk_sg.headline: Syed Saddiq Invites Ong Ye Kung to October Wedding
smalltalk_sg.body: Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman has invited Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to his wedding in October. He joked that he had upgraded bilateral relations to wedding-invitation status.

smalltalk_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Addresses Salary Increase Discussions
smalltalk_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong thanked MPs for participating in salary discussions, stating the increases concern Singapore's future rather than himself or the PAP government.

personal_hk.headline: 動保團體呼籲市民抵制馬術表演Cavalluna
personal_hk.body:
亞洲善待動物組織指於啟德體育館上演的馬術表演Cavalluna涉嫌虐待動物，呼籲市民抵制。
該節目由香港賽馬會主辦及合作，展演期至本周日結束。

personal_sg.headline: Health Minister Ong Ye Kung Invited to Syed Saddiq's Wedding

personal_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong Clarifies Higher Salary Rationale
personal_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong reiterated that salary increases are aimed at securing Singapore's future and are not about himself or the PAP government.
